culprit: cd24778 Update to comply with spec 0.31.2

good.subject: Add new pathological test from cmark upstream (#1008)

explanation.why: The commit changed `isPunctChar` in `lib/common/utils.mjs` to also match Unicode symbol characters (`ucmicro.S`), as spec 0.31.2 requires. `StateInline.scanDelims` in `lib/rules_inline/state_inline.mjs` uses that function for flanking checks. In `~~⚀~~one`, the `⚀` before the closing `~~` is now punctuation, and the character after it (`o`) is not. So the closing run no longer counts as right-flanking and can't close, and the strikethrough renders as literal text. Before the commit, `⚀` was not punctuation, so the closer worked. The same thing happens with any non-ASCII symbol.

fix.patch:
diff --git a/lib/rules_inline/state_inline.mjs b/lib/rules_inline/state_inline.mjs
index 80cb3c5..72aa7d1 100644
--- a/lib/rules_inline/state_inline.mjs
+++ b/lib/rules_inline/state_inline.mjs
@@ -2,6 +2,7 @@
 
 import Token from '../token.mjs'
 import { isWhiteSpace, isPunctChar, isMdAsciiPunct } from '../common/utils.mjs'
+import * as ucmicro from 'uc.micro'
 
 function StateInline (src, md, env, outTokens) {
   this.src = src
@@ -100,8 +101,14 @@ StateInline.prototype.scanDelims = function (start, canSplitWord) {
   // treat end of the line as a whitespace
   const nextChar = pos < max ? this.src.charCodeAt(pos) : 0x20
 
-  const isLastPunctChar = isMdAsciiPunct(lastChar) || isPunctChar(String.fromCharCode(lastChar))
-  const isNextPunctChar = isMdAsciiPunct(nextChar) || isPunctChar(String.fromCharCode(nextChar))
+  // Strikethrough (~) is not part of the spec's emphasis rules, so keep the
+  // previous behaviour there: Unicode symbols (category S) are not punctuation.
+  const isPunct = marker === 0x7E
+    ? (ch) => ucmicro.P.test(String.fromCharCode(ch))
+    : (ch) => isPunctChar(String.fromCharCode(ch))
+
+  const isLastPunctChar = isMdAsciiPunct(lastChar) || isPunct(lastChar)
+  const isNextPunctChar = isMdAsciiPunct(nextChar) || isPunct(nextChar)
 
   const isLastWhiteSpace = isWhiteSpace(lastChar)
   const isNextWhiteSpace = isWhiteSpace(nextChar)
